summary: Compañia de Minas Buenaventura S.A.A. filed Form 6-K announcing first-quarter 2026 production and sales volumes. The filing provides operational metrics only—no M&A, capital markets transaction, or corporate event. Buenaventura reported gold, silver, lead, zinc, and copper production and sales for its direct and associated operations, along with average realized prices. The press release includes operational commentary on specific mines. As a routine operational update filed by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, this is not a special-situation event. No deal terms, strategic review, or structural change is disclosed.
